purpose: Reliable scheduled persistence within the observed short automation execution envelope using one optimistic-concurrency file update plus one readback.
identity_rule: The executing task automation_id must exactly equal its lane automation_id in control_plane.active[].

authoritative_state.history: Every successful update creates an immutable Git commit/blob. Git history is the authoritative historical ledger; separate per-run core/history/finalization file creation is not required.
authoritative_state.legacy_v3_artifacts: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence after v4 migration.

transaction: Fetch isolated control_plane.json and this contract; validate exact protocol/control-plane/lane identity.
Fetch <lane>/latest.json immediately before mutation and retain its current blob SHA as PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA.
Perform at most one optional bounded research/audit retrieval. If unavailable, record DEGRADED/NO_FRESH_DATA; do not abort.
Build one self-contained RUN_RECEIPT containing all material output and failure/degradation fields.
Re-fetch <lane>/latest.json exactly once and verify RUN_ID, automation_id, CONTROL_PLANE_ID, persistence_protocol_version, FINALIZATION_STATUS=VERIFIED and execution_authorized=false.
Only the successful readback makes the run authoritative.

optimistic_concurrency.rule: Do not loop on mutation failures inside a scheduled execution. A failed CAS write is a failed run; next natural invocation retries from fresh state.

runtime_budget.rule: Prepare persistence before optional depth. If time/tool budget is uncertain, skip optional research and persist a truthful degraded receipt.

acceptance.single_run: One updated latest.json blob read back successfully with all required fields/values.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural scheduled receipts with distinct RUN_IDs and distinct latest.json blob SHAs.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five lanes satisfy sustained_lane with exact scheduler IDs/minutes.
